leadText:
A Ruin Maniac (Japanese: いせきマニア Ruin Maniac) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation III games. They are often depicted as stereotypical explorers, shown in Generations and as old men in safari outfits and pith helmets, generally having the appearance of an archaeologist in the field. In Generations and , they are younger and wear fedoras and jackets.

They can usually be seen near any archaeological sites containing rare Pokémon or events. One such in Generations IV and VIII proposes a contest between the and himself to determine which is faster: the player catching 26 , or the Ruin Maniac digging through the Maniac Tunnel.

In Generations III and VI, they use - and Pokémon, whereas in Generations IV and VIII, they use - and Pokémon. They often use , , , and .

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
===== =====
A Ruin Maniac named / is seen battling Valerie in the Battle Dome. While it is unknown who won, what is known is Dusty at some point lost a match, eliminating him from the tournament.

===== =====
In Clobbering Claydol, a Ruin Maniac was briefly seen roaming the as rode on his jetpack.

====Pokémon====
 

 

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
In Find Munchlax!!, a Ruin Maniac is one of the three Trainers searching for . He uses his "ruin excavation skills" to scatter bait and dig a trap.

==Trivia==
The three Ruin Maniacs in are found near each of the caves where the legendary giants are encountered.
In Pokémon GO, "Ruin Maniac" is the name of an achievement awarded for catching at least 10 Pokémon.
